children: said on Wednesday it would acquire Utility Innovation Group, a provider of microgrid solutions and advanced data center power control systems, for about $1.45 billion in cash.
Shares of the power and cooling equipment maker were down about 2% in premarket trading.
Interest in microgrids and onsite power systems has been rising as data center operators seek alternatives to constrained utility grids amid an AI-driven boom in power demand.
The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
